name.en-US: Explanation of the Rule of St. Augustine
name.pt-BR: Explicação da Regra de Santo Agostinho

description.en-US: Dom Aloysius Smith’s English version (1911) of the commentary on the Rule of St. Augustine that tradition attributes to Hugh of St. Victor (doubtful in Migne), in twelve chapters, one for each chapter of the Rule. A separate book from the Latin Expositio in regulam, which divides the text differently.
description.pt-BR: A versão inglesa de Dom Aloysius Smith (1911) do comentário à Regra de Santo Agostinho atribuído a Hugo de São Vítor, em doze capítulos, um para cada capítulo da Regra.

sources.edition: Explanation of the Rule of St. Augustine by Hugh of St. Victor, translated by Dom Aloysius Smith (London: Sands, 1911; Edinburgh: printed by the Edinburgh Press); archive.org OCR text.
sources.description: The preface and the twelve chapters of the translation. Running heads and page numbers are removed; the OCR carries a few slips. The translator’s contents list and any footnotes in the scan are not kept.
sources.tierEvidence: Published in London in 1911, before 1931: public domain in the US.
